widget.title: Two tins
widget.prompt: Which tin has more at the end of the month?
widget.a11y_text: Two tins. In the first, a coin is kept every week and there are four at the end of the month. In the second, every coin is spent the same day, so it is empty.

panels.label: Keep a coin
panels.summary: One coin in the tin each week
panels.detail: Four coins at the end of the month!

panels.label: Spend it all
panels.summary: Every coin goes the same day
panels.detail: The tin is empty. Nothing left for the big thing.
